title: Syed Ammar — portfolio direction
question: Choose the visual direction to carry forward. Emerald, readable sans-serif content, both themes, and your verified career stage stay fixed.

options.label: Technical Field Manual
options.lineage: Engineering inspection sheets and technical manuals
options.thesis: Your professional profile and a real Linux project share one precise technical sheet.
options.viewport: Large Linux / Cloud / Security identity on the left; a real project flow and file register on the right; credentials below.
options.risk: The diagram needs restraint so the human profile stays prominent.

raised.raise: One coordinated interaction rhythm and a clear selected state.
Aligned evidence rows remain readable in one sweep.
Every artifact keeps its evidence type and provenance adjacent.
A single continuous grid governs the whole viewport and both themes.
Every important artifact is explicitly labeled.
One decisive reading axis leads to a clear project action.

options.label: Open Systems Atlas
options.lineage: Network service maps and infrastructure registers
options.thesis: Connect each technical focus to the projects and credentials that support it.
options.viewport: An emerald identity masthead opens onto three linked domains and a project register.
options.risk: Network maps are familiar in infrastructure portfolios; the evidence and human portrait must give this one its character.

options.label: Live-code stage
options.thesis: Your work becomes a set of highlighted source lanes.
options.viewport: A source buffer governs the viewport.
options.case: The performance-code identity points toward software and adds reading effort.
options.risk: The performance-code identity points toward software and adds reading effort.

options.label: Evidence meter bridge
options.thesis: Your evidence is read in parallel channels.
options.viewport: Parallel channels share one aligned ruler.
options.case: Audio instruments weaken role identification and flatten evidence types.
options.risk: Audio instruments weaken role identification and flatten evidence types.

options.label: Provenance patchwork
options.thesis: Each artifact carries its own provenance block.
options.viewport: An unequal grid holds connected evidence.
options.case: Domestic material and unequal blocks weaken technical identity and résumé hierarchy.
options.risk: Domestic material and unequal blocks weaken technical identity and résumé hierarchy.

options.label: Night systems
options.lineage: Urban night bands and illuminated networks
options.thesis: Your domains form one continuous landscape.
options.viewport: Synchronized bands link identity and evidence.
options.case: Cinematic atmosphere takes space from role clarity and specific work.
options.risk: Cinematic atmosphere takes space from role clarity and specific work.

options.label: Systems cutaway
options.thesis: Every project opens as a labeled compartment.
options.viewport: A labeled cross-section reveals work in place.
options.case: The playful scene and equal-scale labels make professional assessment harder.
options.risk: The playful scene and equal-scale labels make professional assessment harder.

options.label: Technical trajectory
options.thesis: Work and learning follow one strong diagonal.
options.viewport: A diagonal path carries the work forward.
options.case: Adventure imagery does not establish demonstrated skills and puts chronology before relevance.
options.risk: Adventure imagery does not establish demonstrated skills and puts chronology before relevance.

canonCard.label: Conventional technical portfolio
canonCard.thesis: A familiar profile-and-project layout, executed with precision.
canonCard.viewport: Introduction and actions beside the portrait; selected projects immediately below.
canonCard.risk: The familiar structure gives the portfolio less distinctive form.
